Never hand-edit: move the pin, re-clone at that tag, and re-run fhir-harness/scripts/pin-ig-terminology.ts. It exists because the owner ruled 2026-09-30 that check:term-mapping's `fhir` half asserts a PUBLISHED IG AT A VERSION rather than a live collection — so the codes must be fixed and offline, not whatever a host serves today. Both hosts are in fact unreachable from CI.
